title: Price Tracker
description: Reads Chainlink Data Feeds on the C-Chain by pair name, rejects stale or non-positive answers, and values an amount of an asset in USD.
prompts: Show the live AVAX price in my app from an onchain oracle
I need a contract that converts an AVAX amount to USD
Track token prices with Chainlink on Avalanche

params.name: maxAge
params.description: Seconds after which a round counts as stale. Fuji feeds can go hours between updates, so keep 24 hours on testnet.

prerequisites: Native gas on the C-Chain for the signer

contracts.name: PriceTracker
contracts.description: Named Chainlink feeds with staleness and sign checks

checks.description: One AVAX is worth a fresh, positive USD amount

review: Every feed address comes from $net.main.chainlink.feeds, never typed in.
maxAge matches the feed's heartbeat on the chosen network; a value below the heartbeat makes reads revert between updates.
Callers handle the StalePrice revert instead of falling back to an old value silently.

frontend.summary: A live price board for major assets with a quick converter.
audience: Users of an app that prices things in USD
journeys: A board of prices with how fresh each is, updating on its own, no wallet needed.
A stale price stays visible, greyed out with its age, instead of disappearing.
flows: Read several pairs at once with latestPrices(pairs); format answers with the returned decimals (8 for USD feeds).
Show updatedAt as the age of the price, and a warning state when a read reverts with StalePrice.
Convert an amount with quote(pair, amount, amountDecimals); for AVAX pass 18 decimals.
Reads need no wallet: use a public client on the network's rpcUrl.
